plan.major: Soil and Waste Resources (Soil Science and Land Management)
plan.notes: Source: official UWSP Sample Graduation Plan, College of Natural Resources (file Grad-Plan-Soil-Science-and-Land-Management.pdf), printed 'Catalog Fall 2026', updated March 2026; filed under 2026-2027 as the current catalog at collection time. Soil and Waste Resources (BS), Soil Science and Land Management Option. The plan states it 'is not meant to serve as an official document' and refers students to their adviser and the University Catalog (https://catalog.uwsp.edu/). Credit ranges and 'or' options resolved per course choice_note (first-listed option used); the modeled total is 120, matching the plan's printed semester subtotals. 'Soils Directed Elective', 'Career Skills Elective', 'Elective/Minor Course', and CGER slots are modeled as choice slots, never as real courses. The plan notes this major alone does not complete 120 credits, so students take electives or a minor; the two 'Elective/Minor Course' slots in semester 8 reflect this. Prerequisites are not listed on the plan; see the catalog. The required Summer Field Experience (7-cr bundle or NRES 475 at 8 cr) and the required 3-cr SOIL 381 summer internship are each modeled as a choice slot in sequence. 2.25 GPA in the major required for graduation (2.0 cumulative). (Fa)=offered fall only; (Sp)=spring only; (Su)=summer only.
